provenance.method: Web search, open and in-page find; bounded quotations plus paraphrased findings
provenance.limits: Community-maintained explanations, no MediaWiki oldid pinned; native implementation and fixed configuration are archived separately. No live battle observation.

result.quotedExcerpt: 目前敌人类单位均无职业
result.paraphrase: Distinguishes native Character/Enemy classes, side and profession. Ordinary profession-restricted target selection commonly lets no-profession units pass; named exceptions exist. Description text saying enemy or operator is not a universal native type predicate.
result.limit: These are community defaults and descriptions; exact selector-specific policy needs native consumer proof. Page refers to client 2.7.71 in its special-mechanism preface.

result.quotedExcerpt: 职业与分支没有任何必然联系
result.paraphrase: Documents eight operator professions plus summon/device professions. Phantom's clone has executor subprofession. Enemy-class units have no profession; examples distinguish no-profession acceptance and explicit exclusion.
result.limit: Does not by itself prove a serialized Prefab type, UnitTypeMask membership or all consumer policies.

result.paraphrase: The list warns that filters other than enemy-kind filtering use handbook data. Combat attributes can vary with stage. Level, movement, kind and attack method are separate filtering dimensions.
result.limit: UI list data cannot prove actual battle values or their initialization timing.

result.quotedExcerpt: 受到来自〖萨卡兹〗敌人的伤害降低30%
result.paraphrase: The base second talent reduces damage from Sarkaz enemies; its Y module also raises damage against non-Sarkaz targets. This is a category-sensitive gameplay use, not evidence that operator dossier race is automatically an enemy battle tag.
result.limit: This batch closes only the base second-talent Prefab/template binding, not every module branch.

result.quotedExcerpt: 攻击使用远程武器的敌人时
result.paraphrase: Explains attack-method based amplification. The Y module extends it to non-attacking targets and can affect enemy-side Character units with no attack-method tag.
result.limit: The archived concrete binding is the ordinary talent with filterNoneApplyWay=false; module extension is a separate configured program.
